revisions.title: The victory that leaves no room for correction
revisions.body: Try hearing this passage not as a proof but as a trap for the proof-maker. Socrates lets the brothers’ rule expand until false belief, ignorance, and even refutation lose their place. My reading is that the comedy comes from this mismatch: a doctrine claiming total victory also removes the shared conditions that make correction—and therefore any serious exchange—possible.
